name: water-reminder
title: Water Reminder
description: Stay hydrated with smart reminders and track your daily water intake with Habitify and webhook integration.
author: leolionart

commands.name: log-water
commands.title: Log Water
commands.subtitle: Record Water Intake
commands.description: Log your water intake and sync with Apple Shortcuts.

commands.name: view-history
commands.title: Water History
commands.subtitle: Today's Log
commands.description: View your water intake history for today with stats.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Water Tracker
commands.subtitle: Menu Bar
commands.description: Track your water intake from the menu bar.

commands.name: reminder
commands.title: Water Reminder
commands.subtitle: HUD Notification
commands.description: Background service to remind you to drink water via HUD.

preferences.name: dailyGoal
preferences.title: Daily Water Goal (ml)
preferences.description: Your daily water intake goal in milliliters.

preferences.name: defaultAmount
preferences.title: Default Amount (ml)
preferences.description: Default water amount for quick logging.

preferences.name: reminderInterval
preferences.title: Reminder Interval (minutes)
preferences.description: How often to remind you to drink water.

preferences.name: webhookUrl
preferences.title: Webhook URL
preferences.description: URL to send water log data via POST request (leave empty to disable).

preferences.name: enableNotifications
preferences.title: Enable Notifications
preferences.description: Enable periodic reminders to drink water.
preferences.label: Show water reminders

preferences.name: enableMenuBar
preferences.title: Enable Menu Bar
preferences.description: Show water tracker in the menu bar.
preferences.label: Show in menu bar

preferences.name: enableConfetti
preferences.title: Enable Confetti
preferences.description: Show confetti celebration when reaching daily goal.
preferences.label: Celebrate goal completion

preferences.name: habitifyApiKey
preferences.title: Habitify API Key
preferences.description: Your Habitify API key (get from Settings > API Credential in Habitify app).

preferences.name: habitifyHabitId
preferences.title: Habitify Habit ID
preferences.description: The ID of your water habit in Habitify.

preferences.name: nocodbApiToken
preferences.title: NocoDB API Token
preferences.description: API Token for your NocoDB table (header: xc-token).

preferences.name: nocodbTableId
preferences.title: NocoDB Table ID
preferences.description: The Table ID from your NocoDB URL (e.g., mf9imfzxmbh8o6l).
